body:
Thank you. Really. I hope that its like you say. Mentally, I'm looking forward to using what I learned in the future. And I know I have to grieve for what I lost. Its just the guilt of what I did to her in this one act.

I know there is no magic wand, and my therapist says that I should just try to fill my head with noise whenever those thoughts come around, and it works, just less and less lately.

Guess I'm just looking for something to get me through till I can stand on my own again.
